why_excerpt.q: Walk me through your last coffee run. What time, where, and what did you order?
why_excerpt.a: Same as always. Out the door 6:45, latte at Simffee, at my desk by 7:15. If I break that chain I'm late for standup.

why_excerpt.q: When did you last pay extra just to avoid waiting?
why_excerpt.a: Last week, 25k for express delivery rather than walk to the pickup point. My mornings are tight, so time costs more than money.

why_excerpt.q: Is there anything you know is bad but you keep using it because switching is a hassle?
why_excerpt.a: My mobile carrier. Three years of bad coverage and I still haven't ported the number. Changing things takes an evening I never have.

why_excerpt.q: Walk me through your last coffee run. What time, where, and what did you order?
why_excerpt.a: 6:40 at Simffee, latte, then school. The whole staff room knows my order.

why_excerpt.q: When did you last pay extra just to avoid waiting?
why_excerpt.a: I don't pay to skip queues, I just leave and come back. Mornings before class are the exception, then I'll pay anything.

why_excerpt.q: Is there anything you know is bad but you keep using it because switching is a hassle?
why_excerpt.a: Our school printer. Everyone complains, nobody files the form. Same with my bank.

why_excerpt.q: Walk me through your last coffee run. What time, where, and what did you order?
why_excerpt.a: 7:10, Simffee, americano. It's a minute from my door, which is the entire reason.

why_excerpt.a: Never. If there's a queue I skip coffee. I'm not walking or waiting for it.

why_excerpt.q: Is there anything you know is bad but you keep using it because switching is a hassle?
why_excerpt.a: I've used the same pharmacy supplier for eleven years. I'd rather live with a small annoyance than restructure my morning.

say_do_gap.says: I choose a coffee shop based on the quality of the beans.

say_do_gap.mechanism_consequence: walk_tolerance is 1, so no shop beyond one cell can win her. Simffee's quality marketing cannot move her; only distance and opening hours can.
